id.description: V1-<n> conformance, V2-<n> implementation, D3-<n> debt, Y-<n> yagni; the per-vector patterns below are enforced by allOf

lens-checked.description: lenses proven exercised on this artifact (lens matrix, see kernel/references/pipeline-model.md)

subject_oid.description: tree OID this row's evidence was read from (review-state subject; coordinator fills it on every new/updated row — schema-optional for backward compatibility)

failure_mode.description: Concrete failure: divergence for claim-gap; undeclared delivered behavior for unclaimed-delivery

conformance_kind.description: Optional, Vector 1 findings only: claim-gap = missing backing/contradiction/overstatement; unclaimed-delivery = delivered behavior absent from the captured declared scope (owner declares/justifies in the PR body or removes; in-scope, blocking)

coverage_ref.description: Optional: coverage ledger page ref + unit group/selector + hash tying this row to its accounting records

side.description: Optional; required when the anchor is not a surviving subject-tree line (deletion / old-side range / metadata event)

oid.description: Optional: tree OID the anchor was read from (old/base side or metadata-event provenance)

range_or_event.description: Optional: old-side range or metadata event ref at its OID (rename / mode / binary / submodule)
